stories.title: TSX Rebounds as Tech Stocks Recover; Celestica Gains 2%
stories.summary: The Toronto Stock Exchange rebounded after a global selloff in tech stocks. Celestica shares gained 2% as part of the recovery. The report does not give the size of the broader TSX move.
stories.whyItMatters: The quick bounce shows how fast sentiment can swing after a broad tech selloff.
whatToWatch: Whether the rebound holds in the next trading session.
Further moves in Celestica and other TSX tech names.
questions: What triggered the original global tech selloff?
Does the rebound extend beyond tech stocks on the TSX?

sources.title: TSX rebounds as tech stocks recover, Celestica gains 2% after global selloff

stories.title: Tesla Winds Down Cybertruck Production as Musk Shifts Focus to Robotaxis
stories.summary: Tesla is winding down Cybertruck production. CEO Elon Musk is shifting the company's focus to robotaxis. The report does not give an end date for Cybertruck output or a robotaxi timeline.
stories.whyItMatters: The pullback marks a strategic pivot for Tesla, putting more investor focus on its robotaxi bet.
whatToWatch: Official confirmation from Tesla on Cybertruck production plans.
New details on the robotaxi rollout timeline.
questions: What happens to Cybertruck orders already placed?
How much of Tesla's capacity shifts to robotaxi development?

stories.title: Democrats Plan a Wave of AI Bills if They Win Control of Congress
stories.summary: Democrats are preparing a flood of AI bills. They plan to introduce them if they take control of Congress. The report does not specify the bills' contents.
stories.whyItMatters: New AI legislation could reshape rules for AI companies and change how investors price regulatory risk in the sector.
whatToWatch: Which AI bills Democrats introduce first.
The outcome of the relevant Congressional elections.
questions: What would the bills regulate: safety, labor, or antitrust?
Would Democrats have the votes to pass them?

stories.title: Alphabet Takes $548 Million Stake in Qualcomm for Data Center Push
stories.summary: Alphabet took a $548 million stake in Qualcomm. The move supports a data center partnership between the two companies. Qualcomm is already an Alphabet partner.
stories.whyItMatters: The stake deepens ties between a major cloud provider and a chipmaker, as data center capacity becomes a key competitive front.
whatToWatch: Details on how the companies plan to expand the partnership.
Qualcomm's next moves in the data center chip market.
questions: What does Alphabet gain beyond the equity stake?
Does this sharpen competition with other data center chipmakers?

stories.title: Trump Media Investors Lost $2.2 Billion While Trump's Stake Holds at $460 Million
stories.summary: Trump Media investors lost a combined $2.2 billion in value. Donald Trump's own stake in the company stands at $460 million. The report does not say over what period the losses occurred.
stories.whyItMatters: The gap between investor losses and Trump's stake value highlights the stock's volatility and concentrated ownership.
whatToWatch: Trump Media's share price in coming sessions.
Any disclosures on changes to Trump's stake.
questions: Over what time frame did the $2.2 billion loss occur?
What is driving the stock's decline?

stories.summary: South Korea's corporate governance reforms have hit a rough patch. Samsung is resisting the push. The report does not detail the specific reforms or Samsung's objections.

whatToWatch: Samsung's formal response to the reform proposals.
Whether South Korean regulators adjust the reform plan.

stories.summary: The US FAA administrator will testify on a $12.5 billion air traffic control overhaul. The report does not give the testimony date or hearing details.

whatToWatch: The scheduled date of the testimony.
Details on how the $12.5 billion will be spent.

What is the timeline for the overhaul?

stories.title: Ctt Pharmaceutical Holdings CEO Buys $450 in Shares
stories.summary: Ctt Pharmaceutical Holdings CEO Ryan Khouri bought $450 in company shares. The purchase is a small insider transaction. The report gives no further detail on the filing.
stories.whyItMatters: Insider buys can signal executive confidence, though this purchase is too small to be a strong signal on its own.
whatToWatch: Whether Khouri or other insiders make larger purchases.
Ctt Pharmaceutical Holdings' next regulatory filings.

stories.title: Guggenheim Starts Yarrow Bioscience at Buy on Graves' Disease Drug Potential
stories.summary: Guggenheim initiated coverage of Yarrow Bioscience with a Buy rating. The firm cited the company's potential in treating Graves' disease. The report gives no price target or further detail.
stories.whyItMatters: A new Buy rating from a major bank can move a smaller biotech stock and draw fresh investor attention.
whatToWatch: Yarrow Bioscience's share price reaction to the rating.
Updates on its Graves' disease treatment pipeline.
questions: How far along is Yarrow's Graves' disease treatment in trials?

stories.title: Knot and De Cos Emerge as Front-Runners to Succeed Lagarde at ECB
stories.summary: Central banking veterans Knot and de Cos are in the race to replace Lagarde at the European Central Bank. Both bring years of central banking experience to the contest. The report does not give a timeline for the succession decision.
stories.whyItMatters: The next ECB president will shape eurozone interest rate policy, a key driver for European markets and the euro.
whatToWatch: Formal nomination steps for the next ECB president.
Any statements from Knot or de Cos on policy priorities.
questions: Are there other candidates in contention?
